data.title: Payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) – returned direct debit
data.summary: Beispielfon Mobilfunk GmbH informs Nele Musterkamp that the direct debit for the July 2025 mobile invoice (€34.99, dated 3 August 2025) was returned by her bank, and a €3.00 return-debit fee was added. The total of €37.99 must be paid by 2 September 2025.
data.explanation: Your bank returned the direct debit for your mobile phone bill, so the provider is asking you to pay the missed invoice plus the bank's return fee yourself. Transfer the total amount (or pay through the customer portal) by the stated date, quoting your customer number if possible, so the account stays in good standing. If you miss this, the provider says normal direct debits will only resume after you pay, and further reminder or dunning fees could follow. If you believe the direct debit failed due to a bank error, check with your bank.
